sources.title: oddadmix (Ahmed Wasfy) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: From-scratch Arabic LMs (0.5M-50M) finetuned into bidirectional translators across 5 language pairs. Identical recipe at every rung; v1 and v2 bases.

sources.title: oddadmix/50M-8192-Nawah-gemma · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A ~51.8M-parameter Gemma-3 architecture Arabic language model pretrained from scratch on 20 billion Arabic tokens with an 8192-token context window. This is the long-context sibling of oddadmix/50M-2048-Emhotob: same corpus, same tokenizer, same parameter count, same token budget, same optimizer schedule.
